response.sql: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM circuits AS c LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_points) AS avg_points, AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_averages GROUP BY country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_averages) AS wins_difference FROM country_averages ORDER BY country;
